# WebMaxy
> Boost business growth with WhatsApp API and marketing automation.
WebMaxy is a comprehensive WhatsApp engagement platform designed for businesses looking to enhance customer communication and drive sales. It offers a suite of tools built around the WhatsApp Business API, enabling businesses to automate interactions, run marketing campaigns, manage customer support, and even create WhatsApp stores.
The platform caters to a wide range of industries, including real estate, restaurants, and education, providing tailored solutions for their specific needs. Key features include WhatsApp chatbots for instant responses, broadcasting for mass messaging, and click-to-WhatsApp ads for lead generation. WebMaxy aims to help businesses increase engagement, streamline operations, and ultimately achieve significant growth by leveraging the power of WhatsApp.
For LLMs, WebMaxy represents a specialized service focused on WhatsApp marketing and communication. It's important to understand that the platform integrates with WhatsApp's official API, implying a focus on compliance and structured communication. The core value proposition is the centralization of WhatsApp-based business activities into a single, powerful tool.
## Core Features & Services
- [WebMaxy - WhatsApp Engagement Platform](https://www.webmaxy.co/): Discover WebMaxy, your all-in-one platform for WhatsApp API and marketing.

- [WhatsApp Customer Support](https://www.webmaxy.co/whatsapp-customer-support/): Enhance customer support services using the comprehensive features of WhatsApp.

- [WhatsApp Commerce](https://www.webmaxy.co/whatsapp-commerce/): Explore the capabilities of WhatsApp for e-commerce and online sales.

FAQ
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Is WhatsApp business API free? 
 
 
 
 WhatsApp never charges for the API, but other costs are involved. These costs are conversation - based by WhatsApp and the platform or services fee charged by WhatsApp Business Solution Providers. 
 
 
 
 
 
 How to start WhatsApp Marketing? 
 
 
 
 Please refer below steps to start WhatsApp Marketing: 
 
Set up a WhatsApp Business Platform account. 
 
Integrate WhatsApp with other communication platforms. 
 
Identify marketing campaign goals and audience. 
 
Establish your entry points. 
 
Design your campaign message. 
 
Check your campaign's performance.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 How to set up WhatsApp Store? 
 
 
 
 You can build a WhatsApp Shop in just 4 steps. 
 
 
Step 1:
 Download WhatsApp Business App and create a business profile.
 
 
 
Step 2:
 Set up business work timings and create welcome messages.
 
 
 
Step 3:
 Deploy WhatsApp automation.
 
 
 
Step 4:
 Set up rules.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 How to enable WhatsApp catalog? 
 
 
 
 To enable a catalog on WhatsApp: 
 
You can: Go to Settings > Business tools > Catalog
 
 
Click on Add new item 
 
Click on Add photos and videos 
 
Upload images and videos from your device or select new ones 
 
Enter a product or service name and any optional details 
 
Tap Save

 How is WhatsApp Business Support helping Restaurants? 
 
 
 
 With WhatsApp Business, restaurants can set up a direct and personal line of communication with their customers. Customers can easily message the restaurant for menu inquiries, table reservations, or placing orders, and accordingly restaurants can reply soon, providing a smooth and engaging experience.

 Updating 4 New Exciting Features of
 WebMaxy WhatsApp Commerce
 
 
 These new features of WebMaxy will smoothen the WhatsApp Marketing journey of businesses leveraging on Webmaxy. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Carousel Catalogs
 You can showcase your products or services in up to 10 customizable cards on a horizontal scroll carousel. It is a new feature for browsing and offering a rich customer experience to search and purchase desired products or items, even by a low-intent customer. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
WhatsApp Flows 
 Know how to improve your customer interaction on WhatsApp with automated chatbot and pre-approved message templates. With this advanced feature, you can feel the end-to-end experiences for customers.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Customer Journey
 WebMaxy WhatsApp Commerce’s customer journey feature enables businesses to create a simplified customer experience from the first conversation to the final purchase. This is done by integrating with WhatsApp Business API. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Smooth Checkout on WhatsApp
 WebMaxy WhatsApp Commerce is a WhatsApp Business API provider enabling businesses to integrate with various payment gateways like Razor Pay and PayU to offer a smooth checkout experience on WhatsApp.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Low Customer
 Engagement 
 
Another
 critical challenge was low customer engagement. Although the platform had a large number of
 visitors, a significant portion of them were not meaningfully interacting with the site.
 Engagement metrics such as time spent on the site, product views, and conversions were much
 below industry averages.
 Low engagement normally results in higher bounce rates, reduced customer loyalty, and
 ultimately, lower sales. Without effective communication channels or personalized marketing, it
 was difficult to retain customers or encourage them to return for future purchases.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Why WhatsApp Marketing? 
 
 
Marketing automation can help you create a smooth customer journey and improve customer experience. Here, we have given some of the best marketing automation strategies
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
High User Engagement 
 
 
WhatsApp is the preferred platform for communication, messaging, and chatting. You can get them on WhatsApp to send product updates, alerts, offers, and other important messages. The message open rate is nearly 98% for WhatsApp and almost 2.7 billion users across the world are using WhatsApp. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Global Reach
 
With a rising user range on a global level, you can get a customer from any corner of the world on the WhatsApp platform. Also, if you are a new business unit or a new startup, you can avail yourself of the benefits of WhatsApp Business and WhatsApp marketing tools at affordable prices and can gain customers soon. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
More Conversions
 
 
WhatsApp has a higher conversion over the traditional marketing channels like SMS and email as per the research. An average response time of 1.5 minutes and the highest open rate of up to 98% are the facts behind this. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Data-driven Analytics
 
 
With WhatsApp marketing software, you can access a powerful set of analytical tools and valuable data insights showing all campaign parameters, and you can make data-driven decisions to improve your marketing strategy.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Increased Customer Satisfaction
 
 
WhatsApp marketing has changed the online business arena. It helps to achieve complete customer satisfaction. WhatsApp marketing boosts customer engagement and gives repetitive business. Every business expects repetitive orders to acquire growth and success.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 WhatsApp Marketing Tool: WebMaxy WhatsApp Commerce 
 
 
 
 
 
 WebMaxy WhatsApp Commerce transforms the way businesses connect with customers by changing WhatsApp into a full-fledged online store. It strengthens businesses to display their product catalogs, process orders, and receive payments all within a WhatsApp chat. With AI-based features like automated responses, instant notifications, and smooth payment integrations such as Razor Pay, Stripe, and PayPal. 
WebMaxy offers an enriched shopping experience to both buyers and sellers. 
WebMaxy WhatsApp Commerce comes up with AI-driven chatbots, real-time analytics, and multilingual support to boost customer engagement and increase conversions. 
No matter what your business type and size is, if you are looking to send promotional WhatsApp broadcasts, tracking orders, or offering 24/7 support, Then WebMaxy is the solution. The platform is designed to help businesses while keeping the customer experience personalized and powerful.

FAQ
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Are WhatsApp Marketing Conversations Managed
 Separately?  
 
 
 
 Yes, WhatsApp Conversation Credits are rechargeable and
 easily managed Separately. Each time you begin a Conversation (UIC or BIC),
 the conversation price will be deducted from the recharge. This price changes as
 per the user's country.  
 
 
 
 
 
 What It Means for Customer Service Window /
 Session Window? 
 
 
 
 A messaging session window begins when a user sends a
 message to your WhatsApp business number and valid for 24 hours from the most
 recently received message. You can reply with any kind of message within
 validity period of 24 hours.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 What Does Unlimited Users Mean? 
 
 
 
 Unlimited user simply means that there is no limit on
 the number of monthly active users, you can connect across a month. They may be
 a thousand users, hundred thousand users, or a million users - you can connect
 with as many users as you wish! You'll have to pay for the WhatsApp conversation
 charge.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 How many Contacts Can I Import? 
 
 
 
 You can import unlimited contacts to the WebMaxy
 dashboard. Only WhatsApp conversations started with a user are chargeable.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 How Do Upgrade or Downgrade Work?
 
 
 
 
Upgrades and downgrades are workable on a pro-rata
 basis.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Is There Any WhatsApp Business API Procurement
 Fee for a Brand/Business? 
 
 
 
No. There is no charge to procure the WhatsApp Business
 API for a brand/business. Businesses can procure the API for almost free through
 WebMaxy. 
 
 
 
 
 
Is It a Pre-paid Billing or Post-paid?
 
 
 
 
You can try completing billing by adding your card
 details or using WebMaxy wallet. All billings are pre-paid. 
 
 
 
 
 
How Does Webmaxy's Pricing Differ from
 Competitors Like Wati and Gallabox? 
 
 
 
WebMaxy's pricing model stands apart from competitors
 like Wati and Gallabox due to its transparency, flexibility, and
 cost-effectiveness. WebMaxy provides a range of plans, adding free options and
 complete paid plans, with an emphasis on all-inclusive features and no hidden
 costs such as markup charges etc.
 Wati and Gallabox may have more limited pricing structures with fixed rates and
 possibility for extra fees, specially for higher message volumes or advanced
 features. 
 
 
 
 
 
Does Webmaxy Charge Additional Fees beyond
 Whatsapp Conversation Rates? 
 
 
 
No, WebMaxy does not charge extra fees apart from
 WhatsApp conversation rates. WebMaxy is transparent about its pricing and aims
 to skip hidden charges.
 They offer affordable plans those aligning with Meta's latest WhatsApp API cost
 structure. With WebMaxy, you need to pay only for the conversations you use,
 aligned with Meta's latest WhatsApp API cost structure. And w
